verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI is an agent framework, so offering managed deployment with an API endpoint is a fair axis for it. However, the evidence shows only self-run options: running an agent behind a web frontend, starting a local uvicorn chat server from the CLI, and durable execution. None of these is a first-party managed runtime that hosts an agent and exposes it as a callable API endpoint. missing for 10: a documented managed or hosted agent runtime, a deploy workflow, an auto-provisioned API endpoint for deployed agents, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can deploy an agent to a managed runtime and call it as an API endpoint
